front.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
front.tldr: Anthropic's assistant can now link bank and card accounts through Plaid to analyse spending and answer money questions, with read-only access and no ability to move funds.

front.title: New York Times in advanced talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
front.tldr: The New York Times Company is close to buying film community site Letterboxd for about $330 million, Deadline reports, with former bidder A24 now out of the running.

front.title: Celtics survive late stampede from Bucks, win 109-102
front.tldr: Boston led by 22 points before Milwaukee stormed back, but Paul George and Derrick White steadied the Celtics for a 109-102 win without Jayson Tatum.

stories.title: Airbnb says it's launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
stories.tldr: Airbnb's planned AI agent will help travellers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings and get help during their stay, with a launch targeted for early 2027.

stories.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
stories.tldr: Meta's Muse assistant can now take video calls as a customisable animated avatar in the US, ahead of a wearable designed to bring the character to life.

stories.title: GPT-6 Cyber: advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
stories.tldr: OpenAI has introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a model built to find exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes while staying within authorised scope.

stories.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
stories.tldr: Startup Axiom Math had its AI agents formally verify the Stacks Project, one of the field's largest proof libraries, betting on verification over unchecked AI-generated proofs.

stories.title: Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots
stories.tldr: Alongside third-quarter earnings, Serve Robotics announced Physical AI Services, a new line offering other companies its connectivity and data tools for robots.

stories.title: Google is ditching Firebase Studio and wants developers to use its newer AI tools instead
stories.tldr: Google is winding down Firebase Studio and steering developers towards Antigravity and Google AI Studio instead.

stories.title: Zipline hits $21.5B valuation as Walmart expands bet on drone delivery
stories.tldr: Drone delivery firm Zipline raised $1.5 billion and deepened its partnership with Walmart, pushing its valuation to $21.5 billion.

stories.title: The FAA is finally phasing out floppy disks from air traffic control
stories.tldr: US air traffic control is finally retiring the floppy disks it has relied on for decades, as the FAA modernises its systems.

stories.title: Apple's first touchscreen Mac is now arriving to customers
stories.tldr: Customers who preordered the touchscreen MacBook Pro, OLED iPad mini, M6 MacBook Pro or M6 iMac are starting to receive them, beginning in Australia and New Zealand.

stories.title: Apple announces a new Mac sales record
stories.tldr: Apple CEO John Ternus said the company sold more Macs in its 2026 fiscal year than in any previous year, on an earnings call this week.

stories.title: Siri AI keeps on improving
stories.tldr: Apple's 27.3 developer betas add Siri AI features to Safari, plus a new Siri AI Developer Preview that commentator Federico Viticci examined in detail.

stories.title: Apple expected to bid for F1 streaming rights in more countries, says Formula 1 CEO
stories.tldr: Apple holds exclusive US streaming rights for Formula 1 and is reportedly set to bid for rights in more countries, F1's CEO said, after a strong first year.

stories.title: Weta FX to invest in Taiwan's Moonshine Studio under AI pact with TAICCA
stories.tldr: The New Zealand effects house behind The Lord of the Rings and Avatar will invest in Taiwanese animation studio Moonshine, part of an AI-focused partnership with Taiwan's content agency.

stories.title: Lionsgate greenlights John Wick animated film with Keanu Reeves
stories.tldr: Lionsgate has greenlit an animated John Wick prequel, with Keanu Reeves signing on to reprise the assassin he has played across the billion-dollar franchise.

stories.title: La Bola Negra wins Denver Film Festival's top prize
stories.tldr: Netflix drama La Bola Negra won Denver Film Festival's narrative feature audience award, the latest regional festival win to boost its awards season chances.

stories.title: 'Everytime' is Sandra Wollner's haunting portrait of grief in the digital age
stories.tldr: IndieWire's review places Wollner's third feature, in the lineage of Aftersun and Personal Shopper, among the standout films of the decade, for how it handles mortality in an online age.

stories.title: Derrick White flipped the switch when the Celtics needed him
stories.tldr: With ice on both knees after the Bucks game, 32-year-old Derrick White explained how he found another gear once Boston's big lead started slipping away.

stories.title: Paul George is still elite, and it's time to talk about it
stories.tldr: Since joining Boston in July's trade for Jaylen Brown, Paul George has quietly played at an elite level, CelticsBlog argues, despite a rocky summer of discontent.

stories.title: Patriots QB Drake Maye named AFC Offensive Player of the Month
stories.tldr: Drake Maye earned his first AFC Offensive Player of the Month award after an October in which he completed 67.2% of his passes for New England.

stories.title: A.J. Brown's knee injury 'raises some concerns' about Patriots future
stories.tldr: Analyst Adam Schefter said A.J. Brown's knee raises concerns about how much longer he can play at a high level, a worry given the first and fourth-round picks New England traded for him.

stories.title: Bill Belichick, Robert Kraft advance in Pro Football Hall of Fame Class of 2027 selection process
stories.tldr: Patriots legends Bill Belichick and Robert Kraft are among 15 candidates still in contention for the Pro Football Hall of Fame's Class of 2027.

stories.title: 1980 F1 world champion Alan Jones dies aged 80
stories.tldr: Alan Jones, the first driver to win a world title for Williams, has died aged 80 after a short illness, having won the 1980 championship.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli opens up on 'very emotional' visit to Ayrton Senna's family estate
stories.tldr: New champion Kimi Antonelli described visiting Ayrton Senna's family home, Fazenda Dois Lagos, ahead of this weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix, calling the trip very emotional.

stories.title: How Mercedes can win the F1 world constructors' title in Brazil
stories.tldr: Mercedes can claim a ninth constructors' championship in Brazil after Kimi Antonelli's title win in Mexico, having taken 12 of the last 19 titles on offer.

stories.title: Contreras and Abreu hope to win Silver Slugger for the first time
stories.tldr: Two Red Sox hitters, Contreras and Abreu, are finalists for this year's Silver Slugger awards, each hoping to win it for the first time.

finally.title: An animated film made in Excel sums up the pointless impulse to create
finally.tldr: Artist Maria Tomazou made an animated short entirely inside Microsoft Excel, a reminder that something worth making doesn't need a practical purpose.
